segments.text: Hello, and welcome to this MOOC, Introduction to Biorisk Management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习这门 MOOC“生物风险管理导论”。

segments.text: I am your instructor, Kenneth, and in this segment, I will be discussing the processing
segments.zh: 我是你们的讲师 Kenneth，在这一部分，我将讨论

segments.text: of samples from COVID-19 patients.
segments.zh: COVID-19 患者样本的处理。

segments.text: COVID-19 patient samples can be in the form of mesopharyngeal swabs in viral transport
segments.zh: COVID-19 患者样本可以是保存在病毒运输

segments.text: medium or in the form of serum samples, blood samples, fecal samples, or urine samples.
segments.zh: 培养基中的鼻咽拭子，也可以是血清样本、血液样本、粪便样本或尿液样本。

segments.text: These will arrive at your facility with the appropriate media required for storage.
segments.zh: 这些样本到达你的设施时，会带有保存所需的相应介质。

segments.text: Upon arrival at your facility, the first step involves cataloging of the samples.
segments.zh: 样本到达设施后，第一步是对样本进行编目登记。

segments.text: This can be done in collaboration with the hospital or the laboratory which has provided
segments.zh: 这可以与提供样本的医院或实验室

segments.text: the samples.
segments.zh: 合作完成。

segments.text: Cataloging of the samples is generally done by coding each sample as patient data must
segments.zh: 样本编目一般是通过给每份样本编码来完成的，因为患者数据必须

segments.text: be protected.
segments.zh: 受到保护。

segments.text: The next step involves opening of the samples in a biological safety cabinet.
segments.zh: 下一步是在生物安全柜中打开样本。

segments.text: All samples derived from patients must be opened in the safety of a biological safety
segments.zh: 所有来自患者的样本，都必须按照标准操作规程，在生物安全

segments.text: cabinet in accordance with standard operating procedures.
segments.zh: 柜的保护下打开。

segments.text: Once you have opened these samples, you need to go to the next step which is inactivation
segments.zh: 打开这些样本后，需要进入下一步，也就是对样本

segments.text: of these samples.
segments.zh: 进行灭活。

segments.text: Inactivation is achieved by heating the sample to a specific temperature or a specific duration
segments.zh: 灭活是通过把样本加热到特定温度并保持特定的

segments.text: of time.
segments.zh: 时间来实现的。

segments.text: In our case, we will heat the sample to 70 degrees Celsius for a duration of 60 minutes.
segments.zh: 在我们这里，会把样本加热到 70 摄氏度，持续 60 分钟。

segments.text: After this procedure, the next step involves extraction of the nucleic acids.
segments.zh: 完成这一步后，下一步是提取核酸。

segments.text: COVID-19 is an RNA virus, so we use an RNA extraction kit to extract the viral nucleic
segments.zh: COVID-19 是一种 RNA 病毒，所以我们使用 RNA 提取试剂盒来提取病毒核

segments.text: acids.
segments.zh: 酸。

segments.text: Viral nucleic acids are extremely unstable and must be stored on ice immediately after
segments.zh: 病毒核酸极不稳定，提取后必须立即

segments.text: extraction.
segments.zh: 放在冰上保存。

segments.text: It is advisable to process the sample directly after receiving it from the patient and proceed
segments.zh: 建议在从患者处收到样本后直接进行处理，并接着

segments.text: to RNA extraction.
segments.zh: 进行 RNA 提取。

segments.text: Once the RNA is extracted, the next step involves quantitative reverse transcription
segments.zh: RNA 提取完成后，下一步是实时荧光定量逆转录

segments.text: polymerase chain reaction.
segments.zh: 聚合酶链式反应。

segments.text: The sample is processed using a real-time thermal cycler.
segments.zh: 样本使用实时荧光定量热循环仪进行处理。

segments.text: Now, as the virus is an RNA virus, it must be converted to cDNA or complementary DNA by
segments.zh: 由于该病毒是 RNA 病毒，必须在逆转录酶的作用下

segments.text: the action of a reverse transcriptase.
segments.zh: 把它转化为 cDNA，也就是互补 DNA。

segments.text: Once the sample of the RNA is reverse transcribed into cDNA, the next step will involve application
segments.zh: RNA 样本被逆转录成 cDNA 后，下一步是加入

segments.text: of specific primers, which will amplify regions of the genome, which are of importance or
segments.zh: 特异性引物，用来扩增基因组中对技术人员和临床医生

segments.text: relevance to the technicians and the clinicians.
segments.zh: 重要或相关的区域。

segments.text: So, we use three basic regions of the genome, the RDRP, the E-gene and the S-gene.
segments.zh: 我们使用基因组的三个基本区域：RDRP、E 基因和 S 基因。

segments.text: These are all genes associated with the viral particles.
segments.zh: 这些都是与病毒颗粒相关的基因。

segments.text: Now, as the virus is being translated and transcribed in the human cell, these copies
segments.zh: 由于病毒在人体细胞中进行翻译和转录，这些 RNA

segments.text: of RNA may be present in different amounts.
segments.zh: 拷贝的数量可能各不相同。

segments.text: So, in a particular RNA sample, you may have variable number of copies of that particular
segments.zh: 因此，在某一份 RNA 样本中，该病毒 DNA，或者说该 RNA 病毒的互补 DNA，

segments.text: viral DNA or the complementary DNA of the RNA virus.
segments.zh: 拷贝数可能是不固定的。

segments.text: This needs to be taken into account when one does the analysis, as the copy numbers of
segments.zh: 进行分析时需要考虑到这一点，因为

segments.text: different genes may have variability.
segments.zh: 不同基因的拷贝数可能存在差异。

segments.text: So, that is a basic overview of the process of handling COVID-19 patient samples.
segments.zh: 以上就是处理 COVID-19 患者样本流程的基本概述。

segments.text: To summarize, it begins with the deactivation of the sample by heat, followed by the extraction
segments.zh: 总结一下，首先通过加热对样本进行灭活，然后用 RNA 提取程序

segments.text: of the viral nucleic acid, which is the RNA using an RNA extraction procedure.
segments.zh: 提取病毒核酸，也就是 RNA。

segments.text: And finally, the sample is processed by quantitative real-time PCR, in which case we reverse transcribe
segments.zh: 最后，用实时荧光定量 PCR 对样本进行处理，在这个过程中，我们把

segments.text: the viral nucleic acid into cDNA and the cDNA is amplified using locus specific primers
segments.zh: 病毒核酸逆转录成 cDNA，再用针对病毒蛋白的基因座特异性引物

segments.text: for the viral proteins.
segments.zh: 对 cDNA 进行扩增。

segments.text: With that, I would like to end this segment.
segments.zh: 这一部分就到这里。

segments.text: If you have any questions, you may post them at the end of this video.
segments.zh: 如果有任何问题，可以在本视频下方留言。

segments.text: Thank you for participating in this MOOC.
segments.zh: 感谢大家参与这门 MOOC。

segments.text: Stay bio-safe.
segments.zh: 请注意生物安全。
